title: Exploring the electrophysiology of Parkinson's disease - magnetoencephalography combined with deep brain recordings from the subthalamic nucleus.
description: This dataset contains simultaneous magnetoencephalography (MEG) and subthalamic nucleus local field potential (STN LFP) recordings from externalized deep brain stimulation (DBS) patients with Parkinson's disease. Recordings were acquired with and without dopaminergic medication during rest, static forearm extension (hold), and self-paced fist-clenching (move). The project aimed to characterize basal ganglia-cortex loop neurophysiology and how it is modulated by movement and medication.
methods_description: Externalized DBS patients underwent simultaneous MEG and STN LFP recordings in medication ON and OFF states. Each movement condition consisted of 5 minutes of rest followed by either static forearm extension (hold) or self-paced fist-clenching (move), with pauses during the movement parts. Some patients were recorded in resting state only.

funding_references.funder_name: The project was funded by ERA-NET Neuron for 3 years.
